name: adb-research-reporting
description: Reporting site for the ADB Research governance stack (Constitution-governed, 17 programs). Runs on port 5173.

scripts.predev: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process'); for (const s of ['sync-articles','sync-evidence','sync-references','sync-docs','sync-topic-sprints','build-deepenings-index']) { if (fs.existsSync('../scripts/'+s+'.mjs')) cp.execSync('node ../scripts/'+s+'.mjs', {stdio:'inherit'}); else console.log('skip '+s+' (upstream scripts/ not present)'); }"
scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process'); for (const s of ['sync-articles','sync-evidence','sync-references','sync-docs','sync-topic-sprints','build-deepenings-index']) { if (fs.existsSync('../scripts/'+s+'.mjs')) cp.execSync('node ../scripts/'+s+'.mjs', {stdio:'inherit'}); else console.log('skip '+s+' (upstream scripts/ not present)'); }"
